title: Booth Collection Totals $2.3 Million At Pook & Pook - Antiques And The Arts Weekly
snippet: **The highest price of session two, and the sale as a whole, went to this West Troy Pottery (New York) six-gallon stoneware crock with a cobalt walking elephant, Nineteenth Century, 13½ inches tall by 14 inches in diameter, which sold to the trade on behalf of a client for $177,800 ($20/30,000).**.
